items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: I later, but not too much later, played with Bobby myself. Played in his bands, both big and little.

ctx.x: Was he playing louder than Hackett or? No. Brunis toned down or what?

No. For Bobby to be heard, Brunis would have had to tone down, because Bobby didn't play louder for the simple reason that he couldn't play louder. I later, but not too much later, played with Bobby myself. Played in his bands, both big and little. Played at the New York World's Fair with him, for example, with a little band. And played in a place on 52nd Street called The Troc, which is not there any longer, across from the second famous door, the more famous famous door, with a big band. And Bobby just never…
